seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [target] show mixed outcomes: pixels,y x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Frame-native 21x21 3x3-block grid: axis band ring 10 (dot 0 when selected), pieces ring 5 (hole 0 when selected), targets solid 11, bg 9.
A1/A2 move selection one block row; A3/A4 move a selected piece one column; with the axis selected A3/A4 are no-ops (this is the 'reflection A3 [target] mixed' case, not a global counter).
Pieces are blocked by the board edge and other pieces; A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Reflections: each off-axis piece block -> row 2A-r (ring 4, hole 4), skipped if off-board or under a piece; a target shows 11 through any hole.
HUD col 63 gains one 12 from the top per effective action only; stateless. Unconfirmed: whether the axis is blocked by pieces.
